description:
Functional specifications / files: no production changes. After implementation/integration, present completed existing delivery modal showing grouped failed parts on one message, successful transcript messages, partial success and unconfirmed labels.
Tests/branches: provide screenshots or live review evidence for mixed outcomes, all failures, no failures, keyboard/focus, long filenames and light/dark themes. Existing component/LiveView tests must pass; no new feature E2E authored before explicit approval.
Mocking: representative persisted local fixtures only; do not use real external recipients.
Documentation: record approver, date, source and exact approved scope here. Prior policy discussions are not final UX approval.
Action reuse: not applicable, human acceptance gate. Keep open until explicit approval after completed implementation; material UX changes reopen it. Blocks consolidated feature E2E.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.
title: [zaq-9j8.10] Obtain human approval of grouped delivery-failure UX
